Internal helper: variable names given to an argument, in quotes or bare

Source: R/compare.R
dot-jst_names_given.Rd

categorical = "Age", categorical = Age, categorical = c(Age, "Income"): a string, a bare name, or a c() of either, read as names without evaluating them, so a bare name is the data frame's variable whatever the workspace holds (ruling R18). Anything else – a name holding names, a computed list – is evaluated and must give names. Session 375, for jcrosstab()'s categorical =.

Usage

.jst_names_given(
  sub,
  env,
  data,
  arg,
  data_name = NULL,
  example = "Age",
  default_used = FALSE
)

Arguments

sub

The argument, unevaluated.

env

The caller's environment.

data

The data frame.

arg

The argument's name, for the stop.

data_name

The data frame's name, for the not-found stop.

example

A variable to name in the stop's example.

default_used

Logical; the data frame is the juse() default, so the not-found stop carries its hint, as every not-found stop does (Session 377).

Value

Character vector of names; empty for NULL.
